_reference_note: REFERENCE IMPLEMENTATION of docs/HERB_FORMULA_CARD_SPEC.md. This is what one herb record looks like at the target standard, built from both benchmark sources. Use it as the shape to migrate the other 201 herbs to. Chinese content sourced from CloudTCM; English clinical structure from American Dragon; where a value exists on only one side it is marked in field_sources with translated:true so nothing pretends to be sourced in both languages when it is not.
category_en: Herbs that Release the Exterior: Warm, Acrid (Wind-Cold Diaphoretics)

properties.source_agreement: CloudTCM and American Dragon agree independently on 辛微苦溫/肺膀胱. The previous record said only 'Acrid; warm' and omitted 微苦.

dosage.other_forms_en: Tincture 1-3ml; also in pills and powders
dosage.notes_zh: 晚間服用可能興奮中樞神經，易致失眠；宜日間服。
dosage.notes_en: Evening dosing may stimulate the CNS and cause insomnia; prefer daytime dosing.

by_pattern.rationale_en: Raw form is the strongest diaphoretic
by_pattern.dose_note_zh: 取全量範圍之較高端，中病即止，不可過汗
by_pattern.dose_note_en: Toward the upper end of the range; stop once the sweat is achieved, do not over-sweat

by_pattern.purpose_en: Calm wheezing and stop cough (obstructed Lung qi)
by_pattern.preferred_form_en: Prepared / honey-fried (Zhi or Mi Zhi Ma Huang)
by_pattern.rationale_zh: 蜜炙可減弱發汗力，且有潤肺之功；作用時間延長
by_pattern.rationale_en: Honey-frying reduces the diaphoretic action, adds a moistening effect on the Lung, and prolongs duration
by_pattern.dose_note_zh: 多用中低劑量，重在宣降而非發汗
by_pattern.dose_note_en: Lower to middle of the range; the aim is diffusing and descending, not sweating
by_pattern.source_quote_zh: 蜜炙用可減弱發汗力，且有潤肺之功。故…平喘止咳多炙用

by_pattern.dose_note_en: Reduce by age and body weight
by_pattern.source_quote_zh: 麻黃絨發汗力弱，多用於兒科

by_pattern.preferred_form_zh: 減量，或改用麻黃絨；必要時配補氣藥
by_pattern.preferred_form_en: Reduce dose, or switch to Ma Huang Rong; pair with qi tonics if needed
by_pattern.rationale_en: Over-sweating damages the upright qi, especially in the depleted

dosage.overdose_source_note: CloudTCM: 高劑量可能引起心悸、呼吸急促、噁心嘔吐、失眠、震顫。Note the overlap with the cardiac contraindications - palpitations are both an overdose sign and the reason cardiac patients are excluded.

actions_indications.action_en: Induces sweating and releases the exterior

patterns.pattern_en: Wind-Cold invading the Lung; Tai Yang stage
patterns.clinical_picture_zh: 無汗、惡寒、發熱、頭痛、脈浮緊
patterns.clinical_picture_en: Anhidrosis, chills, fever, headache, tight floating pulse

actions_indications.action_en: Disseminates and facilitates Lung qi; calms wheezing and stops cough

patterns.clinical_picture_en: Cough and wheezing with chest oppression

patterns.clinical_picture_zh: 浮腫起於頭面、來勢較急，兼表證
patterns.clinical_picture_en: Acute-onset edema beginning in the face, with exterior signs
Cold painful joints, relieved by warmth

patterns.pattern_en: Yin sores; toxic sores without a head
patterns.clinical_picture_en: Diffuse swelling without a head, normal skin colour

chemical_composition_note_zh: 含麻黃鹼（ephedrine）類生物鹼等四十餘種成分。
chemical_composition_note_en: Over forty constituents, principally ephedrine-type alkaloids.

processing.effect_zh: 發汗力略減，用於體弱者
發汗力再減，作用時間延長，偏於潤肺止咳
processing.effect_en: Further reduced diaphoretic, prolonged duration of action

contraindications_zh: 不宜大劑量使用，過汗傷正
肝陽上亢、陰虛火旺者忌用
高血壓、心臟病、癲癇及抽搐病史者慎用
自汗、盜汗、腎不納氣之虛喘者慎用
失眠、胃潰瘍、甲狀腺功能亢進、青光眼、前列腺肥大、糖尿病者慎用
contraindications_en: Do not use in large doses - excessive sweating weakens the body
Contraindicated in Liver Yang Rising and Yin Deficiency Fire
Caution in pregnancy and while nursing
Caution with hypertension, heart disease, epilepsy, seizure disorders, convulsions
Caution with deficiency spontaneous sweating, night sweats from Yin deficiency, Kidney qi failure wheezing
Caution with insomnia, stomach ulcers, hyperthyroidism, glaucoma, prostatic enlargement, diabetes, anorexia, bulimia, cardiac asthma

herb_drug_interactions.with_zh: 擬交感神經藥物、單胺氧化酶抑制劑
herb_drug_interactions.risk_en: Additive stimulant effect - do not combine

herb_drug_interactions.with_en: Beta blockers (atenolol, metoprolol, sotalol, propranolol, labetalol)
herb_drug_interactions.risk_zh: 可能降低其療效（麻黃升高正腎上腺素）
herb_drug_interactions.risk_en: Beta blocker effect may be reduced; herb increases norepinephrine

herb_drug_interactions.risk_zh: 可能加重水分與電解質流失
herb_drug_interactions.risk_en: May increase water and electrolyte loss

toxicity_note_zh: 有小毒。中毒解救可用 atropine。節部（莖節）小毒，傳統須除去。麻黃根功效相反（斂汗），可用於過量。
toxicity_note_en: Slightly toxic; atropine is the antidote. The leaf-segment nodes are slightly toxic and are traditionally removed. Ma Huang Gen (the root) has the opposite action and is used for overdose.

major_combinations.purpose_zh: 風寒表實，發熱惡寒無汗
major_combinations.purpose_en: Wind-Cold excess with fever, chills and no sweating

major_combinations.purpose_zh: 肺熱咳喘（麻杏石甘湯法）

major_combinations.with_en: Shi Gao, Huang Qin, Sang Bai Pi
major_combinations.purpose_zh: 熱壅較重，氣喘、發熱、鼻翼煽動
major_combinations.purpose_en: More severe heat obstruction with wheezing, fever, nostril flaring

major_combinations.with_en: Bai Zhu, Fu Ling Pi, Sang Bai Pi
Gan Jiang, Xi Xin, Zhi Ban Xia
major_combinations.purpose_zh: 外寒內飲之咳喘（小青龍湯法）
major_combinations.purpose_en: Wheezing/cough from exterior Wind-Cold with interior cold fluid

major_combinations.with_en: Shu Di Huang, Bai Jie Zi, Lu Jiao Jiao

related_formulas_note: CloudTCM lists 60+ formulas containing 麻黃; the four above are the canonical teaching examples and are the ones present in this repo's formula canon.

field_sources.actions_indications_zh_note: Chinese action names and clinical pictures follow standard TCM terminology matching CloudTCM's 傳統功效; the pattern-nesting structure follows American Dragon. translated:true where no Chinese original was quoted.
